config_keys.coop_objective: False (master switch; False/absent = byte-identical legacy search)
config_keys.coop_solo_cap: 16 (solo rollouts only for top-N candidates by group gain per WM call; None = all, batched into the candidate call)
config_keys.coop_diversity: True (finalists/top-k: top coop_keep_top by score, then greedy max-min descriptor spread among candidates >= pool median score)
config_keys.coop_active_accel: 0.3 m/s^2 (|issued plan - issued policy| above this = active second)
config_keys.coop_novelty: False (k-NN novelty vs verified bank; needs coop_novelty_bank)
config_keys.coop_novelty_weight: 0.5 (x std of the call's scores, times z-scored k-NN distance)
config_keys.coop_novelty_bank_sha256: None or sha256 of the descriptor list (content-addressed COOP_BANK_<sha>.json)

descriptor: per member [participates, onset_s, early mean, plan mean, mean |dev|] of ISSUED plan command (post feasibility clamp) minus ISSUED policy command (WM policy forecast under the same clamp); z-normalised over the searched pool; bank side: role summary (ramp lane 2 / mainline) of SUMO issued_safe - mappo_safe

gpu_cost_multiplier_estimate.basis: live it2_K2 label-list8 shape (iterations 2, screen_K 2 H300, final_K 8 H<=420, top_k 8, finalists 8), coop_solo_cap 16; action x future (action x future x horizon-s)
gpu_cost_multiplier_estimate.extra_wm_calls_per_search: one capped solo call per screen iteration (2) when population > cap; final solos batched into the K8 call

enable_for_next_batch.what_changes_live: GPU workers must run the 93e1cd22 mppi_search.py + coop_search.py + ls_gpu.py (+ niche_collect.py validator); cpuQ collector must run niche_collect.py + ls_collection.py. Both need the usual source-bound CPU qualification and rolling drained-boundary GPU handover by the live agent (not done here). Without the config file the new sources behave byte-identically.
enable_for_next_batch.cpuQ_enable: cd <qualified source root>/pytools && python -m tools.coopmwm.coop_search enable <COLLECTION_ROOT> [--lambda 1.0] [--solo-cap 16] [--alternate] [--bank-descriptors BANK_DESC.json  (writes COOP_BANK_<sha>.json beside it; copy to the GPU bank dir and export COOPMWM_COOP_BANK_DIR)]   # writes immutable LS_COOP_SEARCH_CONFIG.json (open 'x'); the collector loads it at supervisor start; new admissions then carry search_config = it2_K2 niches1/4 + coop keys (--alternate: coop on ordinals with (ordinal//2)%2==0, an outcome-blind 2x2 with niche parity)
enable_for_next_batch.bank_descriptors: python -m tools.coopmwm.coop_search bank-descriptors PLANS.json --out BANK_DESC.json   # PLANS.json = list of {plan:{members, issued}, lanes:{vid:lane}, policy_commands} from SUMO branch observable issued_safe / mappo_safe
enable_for_next_batch.gpu: no new GPU CLI: plan_service/mppi_runtime pass record.search_config (validated by niche_collect.validate, binding niche_comparison=True) into mppi_search.search; coop report lands in result.coop_objective, per-finalist result.finalists[i].coop and collection_top8[i].coop; ls_collection copies coop_objective into labels

caveats: Synergy is WM-predicted; solo gains are paired vs 'policy' in the same WM call, the capped screen solos use a second call with the same K/H (CRN futures by index).
Diversity lowers the mean synergy of the 8 finalists vs synergy-only ranking (it spreads them) but keeps the top-2; set coop_diversity=False to compare.
Diversity and the measured-only finalist rule select among the 2x16 candidates with computed solos in the live shape; widen coop_solo_cap to widen that set (cost rises ~linearly).

review_fixes.1_imputation: uncapped screen candidates get the MIN computed synergy of their call (pessimistic); imputed candidates are finalist-ineligible; one extension call (screen K/H) computes solos when measured < finalists or a niche has none; logged per screen: imputed_share, solo_extended; result: extended_candidates, solo_rollouts.extension. Live it2_K2 with cap 16: imputed_share = (N-16)/N per screen (0.6 for m=2 .. 0.87 for m=6); 2x16 measured >= 8 finalists, so no extension call in the live shape
review_fixes.2_niches: coop with niches>1: finalists and top-k keep best-of-each-niche first (by coop score among measured), then farthest-point descriptor fill; iteration and per-niche best/mean_rel_cost (and repulsion choice) use the plain group-gain cost; coop versions logged as best/mean_coop_rel_cost
review_fixes.3_bank: search_config carries coop_novelty_bank_sha256 only (niche_collect.validate rejects an embedded coop_novelty_bank and malformed digests); GPU host resolves COOP_BANK_<sha>.json from coop_search.BANK_DIRS or $COOPMWM_COOP_BANK_DIR and re-verifies the content digest; the enable CLI writes the bank file into the collection root (copy it to the GPU bank dir)
review_fixes.4_golden: test_off_is_byte_identical_to_base_b20bec2f compares output and WM-call digests for 4 cases (niches 1/4 x default/live it2_K2 shape) x 3 off variants against tools/coopmwm/fixtures/coop_off_golden.json generated from the base b20bec2f mppi_search.py (sha256 f2faeeeecf06eb74d22df56300dae39ec31d7afabb664d25a47f5a0650567c77); on Linux set COOPMWM_COOP_BASELINE=<base mppi_search.py> to evaluate the base module on the same BLAS

data_selection_knobs.participation_rule: coop_active_accel=0.3 m/s^2 and coop_active_min_s=5 s: a member "participates" if >= 5 s with |issued plan - issued policy| > 0.3 m/s^2; onset = first such second. These are DATA-SELECTION knobs of the descriptor (they change which plans are spread apart, hence which 8 reach SUMO), adopted from the PLAN_TYPES_20261103 analysis thresholds, not fitted; treat a change as a registered config change
data_selection_knobs.others: coop_early_s=10, coop_keep_top=2, coop_solo_cap=16, coop_lambda=1.0, coop_novelty_k=3, coop_novelty_weight=0.5 are likewise registered selection/score knobs
